ratios.quote: Our actual leverage for the four consecutive quarters ended December 31, 2025 was 4.58 , which is below the maximum leverage of 6.00 .
Our actual interest coverage for the four consecutive quarters ended December 31, 2025 was 3.48 , which is above the minimum interest coverage of 2.00 .

parsed.notes: Leverage is debt to adjusted earnings; interest coverage is adjusted earnings to interest expense, both over four consecutive quarters. Limits reflect Amendment No. 5 (December 2025). The maximum leverage of 6.00 applies through September 30, 2026, then steps to 3.75 by December 31, 2028. Minimum coverage is 2.00 through June 30, 2027 and 2.50 from September 30, 2027.
